Bill.BriefDescription: Preventing local jurisdictions from modifying state minimum wage laws.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to state preemption of minimum wage laws; andadding a new section to chapter 49.46 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No political subdivision shall modify, in any respect, theminimum wage requirements of this chapter through ordinance,resolution, or other legislative action. (2) For the purposes of this section, "political subdivision" meansa county, city, special purpose district, agency of the state, or anyother municipality or public body created under state law.
